text:
Thank you for writing in and for giving us a clear account of what happened with your companion's journey. You said the trip disruption left you frustrated, that the handoff between teams did not feel smooth, and that you want a fair review of the missed connection and the care shown to your pet.

We are sorry this experience fell short of the standard we aim to provide at Aurelia Skyways. When travel plans change suddenly, it can create stress for both the traveler and the animal, and we understand why that would feel discouraging. The Companion Animal Travel Desk treats each case as a shared responsibility, so we review the service path carefully, confirm what was communicated to the crew, and look at where support can be improved. The report you sent gives us a solid starting point, and we appreciate that you took the time to document the details calmly.

<<FACT F116>>

We have also reviewed the delayed departure portion of your complaint and will keep the findings tied to the rest of the case review. <<FACT F109>>

What we can share right now is that your concern has been moved into the regular escalation track for a closer look. That means we will check the transfer notes, verify the timeline, and make sure the companion animal handling steps were followed as intended. If anything was missed, we will address it directly and work toward a fair resolution based on the service record and the policy that applies. We also use this process to improve future handoffs so travelers are not left without clear guidance when plans shift.

Please keep any supporting documents handy in case the review team asks for them, since complete records help us reach the cleanest outcome. We know you are looking for accountability as well as reassurance, and we want to provide both in a way that feels respectful and straightforward. Our aim is to turn this into a better experience for you and a safer, smoother one for future companion animal travel.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
